# MCP Commands

Every command the `mcp` module offers, from its declarations, in order of the resource each acts on. Each command's help says the same.

## `lnk mcp serve`

Serve Link's declared command tools over the Model Context Protocol on stdio

```usage
lnk mcp serve [--read-calls]
```

It takes `--read-calls`, boolean: Print the names of read-only calls for sandbox tool registration, without serving. It answers `mcp.served`.
